Excluding it would not have been allowed to change the verdict and it does not.

scoring_rule: STANDARD.md -> THE PHONE TEST / SCORE THE IDEA, NOT THE NOUN (Miguel, 2026-09-06): a reader who names the drawn content, its container, or a sibling noun of the same thing PASSES; only a DIFFERENT thing, a hedge or 'cannot tell' FAILS. The arithmetic over those judgements is production.consensus': <=1 different, and at least half the reads `sure`.
